text:
Harper L.: FYI onboarding reports: Go generator example doesn't stop when callers cancel the ctx. Small repro: start generator, read first token, cancel -> goroutine lingers.

Harper L.: Repro snippet we gave support:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
_, _ = iter.Next()
cancel()
// expect quick return, sometimes blocks
```

Diego R.: Which transport?

Harper L.: net/http in the sample. Debug shows auth refresh + retry can reopen a stream and the original reader is stuck on Read().

Mina Z.: That's rough. Node/py abort streams on cancel. For Go we shipped without a solid Close() on the iterator. We should add a clear lifecycle: Close cancels request, closes body, and makes Next() return context.Canceled immediately.

Diego R.: Short-term mitigation: update sample to `defer iter.Close()` and change read loop to also watch ctx.Done() and call iter.Close(). I'll add the snippet to the Quickstart.

Harper L.: I pushed a tiny sample change in draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/999 (uses defer iter.Close()).

Mina Z.: For SDK patch: implement io.Closer on the iterator, ensure Close cancels the underlying http.Request context, and suppress transport retries for streaming calls. Could add a per-call option like `RetryMode: "none"` for streams.

Diego R.: I can take the transport work. Plan: add a `NoStreamRetries` flag in request metadata and default streaming endpoints to true. Then write tests that simulate 401 refresh racing with cancel.

Mina Z.: I'll add unit tests that assert Next() returns within 100ms after Close() and a small integration that snapshots runtime.NumGoroutine() before/after Close() to catch leaks. Add CI gate so regressions fail.

Harper L.: Good. Also consider exposing a `BufferLimit` option so iterator doesn't keep unbounded tokens if caller stops reading. That will reduce memory retention on cancelled streams.

Diego R.: Agreed, follow-up issue for buffer/backpressure. For now, Close + NoStreamRetries should stop the immediate onboarding pain.

lint-bot: Created issue #2501: "go-sdk: generator stream cancel lifecycle & transport retry" and added labels bug, ux.

Harper L.: Thanks. Once SDK changes land, I'll update onboarding notes and send a short note to the new-users channel with the Quickstart snippet.

Mina Z.: Will link PRs when ready.
